sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 2 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SNDK、MU、MRVL、NBIS、AMD。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • June nonfarm payrolls only 57K (expected 110K), with the prior two months revised down by a combined 74K. The unemployment rate fell to 4.2%, but the labor force participation rate also dropped to 61.5% (with obvious cosmetic factors), while hourly wages rose to 3.5% YoY. After the data was released, bets on a September rate hike were fully pushed back (previously implying roughly a 30% probability). The hawkish tone of new Fed Chair Warsh is still weighing on the market—the community’s logic of “bad data = no rate hike = buy” failed to translate into gains today.
  • The second bloodbath in semiconductors/memory continued (intraday as of 12:03 ET): SMH -3.9% (596), SNDK plunged -11.4% (1801, approaching the “1776” meme level), MU broke below the 1000 level to 986 (-4.5%), AMAT -7.6%, MRVL -8.4%, NBIS -7.9%, IREN -10.9%, INTC -3.4%, QCOM -4.1%, AMD -4.5%, while leveraged SOXL collapsed to -14.3% over two days. Catalysts piled up: a California class-action lawsuit accused Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron of colluding to restrict output and driving DRAM prices up 700% over four years.
  • Meta backlash and giveback: After surging 11% yesterday on news of “renting out surplus compute,” it fell -4.2% today to 587, breaking below the lower end of yesterday’s gap-up range. The community blamed Zuck for this round of AI/memory selling.
  • TSLA sell-the-news: Q2 deliveries of 480K far exceeded expectations (Wall Street consensus around 406K), yet the stock fell -6.6%, breaking below 400 to 397 and hitting an intraday low of 394; bearish puts made huge profits.
  • AAPL single-handedly supported the market +4.1% (306), MSFT +1.3% (389): The two giants offset tech’s bleeding. Dow proxy DIA rose against the trend by +0.75% (526) to a new stage high, SPY only edged down -0.21% (744), while QQQ was dragged down to -1.45% (715) by its semiconductor weighting.
  • Crypto and memes strengthened independently: MSTR +5.6%, COIN +3.3%, HOOD +4.3% (briefly rushed to 120 intraday), RIVN +9.8%.
  • Market holiday schedule: On 7/2, the bond market closes early at 14:00 ET; on 7/3, stock/options/bond markets are closed all day, with shortened futures trading.

社区气氛：极度混乱、焦虑和痛苦。看跌情绪和自嘲式绝望占主导地位。节前的抛售让“250岁生日被毁了”成为集体哀嚎的主旋律——但这是一种高度扭曲的恐慌，因为SPY实际上只是微红，而道指仍在上涨。真正的出血是在半导体/内存领域重仓的期权参与者中。

恐惧/贪婪：情绪层面接近极度恐惧（很多人喊着“热线热线”、“爆仓”、“炸掉我的港口”），但VIX仍然处于低位（评论反复抱怨“VIX还是zzzz”），并且没有出现系统性的指数级崩盘。这是行业层面的踩踏，而不是大市场的崩盘。

情感与现实：对比是巨大的。评论区充斥着哀嚎，仿佛出现了“5%的暴跌”，而在实际交易中，SPY仅下跌了0.2%，道琼斯指数仍然是绿色的。多位用户指出：“看评论，我以为下降了5%，后来一看，居然是绿的。”问题是，每个人都押注于半导体和 0DTE，因此 0.5% 的指数波动足以消除杠杆头寸。

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
